Die betriebliche Weiterentwicklung der Systeme erfolgt unter Berücksichtigung der Empfehlungen aus der Architekturverantwortung des AN sowie der Vorgaben des ZDF. Die Umsetzung der jeweils zu beauftragenden Leistung erfolgt gemäß dem durch den ZDF-seitigen Projektleiter festzulegenden Vorgehensmodell, das auf die Notwendigkeiten des Projektes oder Vorhabens anzupassen und abzustimmen ist. Die Beauftragung und die Abrechnung erfolgen bei Bedarf im Rahmen des jeweiligen Projekts in Abstimmung mit und nach Freigabe durch den AG. Die zu erbringenden IT-Vorhaben werden im Q1 des Abrechnungsjahres als Grobplanung für den Zeitraum von 365 Tagen zwischen dem AN und AG abgestimmt. Scope of Works The proposed project comprises constructing a new two-storey training building (gross internal floor area 700 sqm approx.), alterations to the BA building & new training tower, new storage shed & gas compound and upgrade works to external yard. The site is a brownfield site (adjacent to existing dwellings). The proposed new building is a two-storey structure comprised of RC column and beam construction with composite cladding finish. Construction comprises concrete ground beams on CFA piles, blockwork rising walls, concrete floor slab, metal stud partitions internal walls, insulated composite cladding panels to external walls, pre-cast concrete first floor and roof slab, external double-glazed windows and doors, internal doors and screens, mechanical and electrical services, internal floor, wall, and ceiling finishes, flat roof finish, decoration internally, and associated external works. Design Team An IDT team has been appointed for the project, the full Project Team members are as follows: SELECTION CRITERIA Works Contractor Suitability The Contracting Authority is seeking a contractor capable of delivering the new works within a live operational fire station campus

It is emphasised, however, that this figure is provided strictly for indicative purposes only. Duration The programme estimated is 12-months for construction stage. The anticipated works start in Q2 2027. PROJECT BACKGROUND Project Objectives The project will upgrade the fire service training facilities at the existing Dundalk Fire Service Learning and Development Centre site. It combines a new two storey training centre with refurbishment and extension of the Breathing Apparatus (BA) building, a new training tower and improved external training facilities. No works are proposed to the existing main fire station building in the Stage 1 Report. Scope of Works The proposed project comprises constructing a new two-storey training building (gross internal floor area 700 sqm approx.), alterations to the BA building & new training tower, new storage shed & gas compound and upgrade works to external yard.
